== Build notes (2026-10-27) ==
* Built from a Wayback CDX crawl of <code>decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/</code> (626 URL keys). Every cited capture passed the strict capture check (replay at the exact timestamp plus a CDX row).
* Score sheets: only the 31 listed survive in the Wayback Machine; other event codes on the day schedules have no archived score page.
* Screenshots: web.archive.org refused connections from the build machine's browser, so the three screenshots were rendered with headless Chrome from the archived HTML and archived images fetched earlier. A few decipher.com-wide icons that were never archived are blank.
* The site's images are on [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs#Website images]].
